# Keep close-button labels and cancellation behavior separate from icon styling

The shortcut modal uses a native type=button close control with a Fluent title and a decorative empty-alt icon. Its click route calls close; both close and the dialog cancel route respect #isBusy. Storybook’s icon-only round and modal-close examples have no label text, so their appearance markup is not an accessibility-complete production template. Preserve the real control’s naming and cancel guard when applying shared icon styles. Title text in source does not prove the final accessible name on all platforms. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or accessibility session was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: Shortcut modal controls and accessible naming.
